title.zh: Treasury Drops Crypto Wallet Surveillance Rules
title.en: Treasury Drops Crypto Wallet Surveillance Rules

current_state.zh: FinCEN withdrew its 2020 unhosted crypto wallet reporting proposal and rescinded its 2023 designation of crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern, while stating it will continue monitoring mixers and may take future action.
